events.title: Demo update 1.0.18: you asked, we listened
events.summary: Howdy, partners! Everything in this update comes from your emails and forum posts. Thank you! Camera keys your way: rebind every camera key in Settings > Controls and choose what the mouse wheel does. Garages and warehouses keep a clear area in front of their gates, so trucks always have room to come and go. On a quiet field, trucks now drive straight from the garage to the tank. Tex's tips wait for you: a new tip no longer replaces the one you are reading. Easier branching: the drill bit follow

events.title: Texas Oil Baron is in Steam Next Fest: the free demo is waiting for you
events.summary: Howdy, partners! Steam Next Fest is here and Texas Oil Baron is part of it. The free demo is ready to download, so grab your hard hat and come drill some Texas dirt. events.title: Demo update 1.0.14 to 1.0.16: new camera controls and more
events.summary: Howdy, partners! Three more demo updates are live (1.0.14 to 1.0.16), and once again most of it comes straight from your feedback on the forum and by email. Thank you, every message helps! Camera and controls New camera controls in the side view, the same above and below ground: W/S moves the camera up and down (underground and back to the surface), A/D left and right, and the mouse wheel or Q/E moves through the ground slices (away / toward you). events.title: Demo update 1.0.12 + 1.0.13: your feedback in action
events.summary: Howdy, partners! Two demo updates in one post, both shaped by your feedback. Thanks to everyone who filled in the feedback form in the demo, keep it coming! New New "Interface size" setting (100-150%) in Settings > Gameplay. Text and UI scale live, in game and in the main menu. Default is now 110%. Top-down (drone) view: zoom with the mouse wheel and move the camera over the field with WASD. Dry pumps are now marked: a "Dry" tag appears above a pump that stopped because its deposit ran out.
